selection_method: Intermediate point between measured gain 0.2 and reference gain 0.6; not a model-optimized or validated optimum.
comparison_metrics: steady low-speed motion and stopping ripple
raw peak and 10 ms averaged step overshoot
decision_rule: Compare all three gains. Prefer 0.4 as compromise only if effort and overshoot decrease and tracking remains substantially better than 0.2. Report tradeoffs; do not declare every metric improved. Persistent low-speed stiction is not solved by an intermediate P gain.
